design: Exploratory TP/FP-based case illustration. V1 added nondecreasing precision and stable ranking requirements and had zero candidates. Aggregate diagnostics subsequently showed six candidates satisfying only TP gain and <=2 additional FP per seed; this V2 explicitly removes the extra precision and ranking eligibility filters before identifying/exporting the new patient.
eligibility: >=20 total channels; both EZ/NEZ; no EZ minimum; exclude the three existing cases. DRE mean TP must increase and >=2 seeds must increase TP. No precision or ranking eligibility restriction; report them all.
fp_tiers: All three DRE seeds FP change <=0
All three DRE seeds FP change <=2 channels
selection: First nonempty tier; maximize DRE mean TP increase, then minimize mean FP change, then maximize equal-weight mean delta AUROC/Recall10, then fixed identifier hash.
thresholds: Original frozen validation-selected thresholds, unchanged; no new models, calibration, inference, score transformations or ensembles.
privacy: CASE-F01/CH aliases outside trusted server; real identities/original channel names private.
